Container.Name: LLDAP
Container.Overview: A lightweight LDAP server for user management with a web interface. For more information please visit the GitHub repository.

Config.Name: Data path
Config.Description: The default path for LLDAP configuration files, this is where your user configuration etc will be stored.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Set a random string of characters as it is used for your JWT secret.

Config.Name: LDAP Admin Password
Config.Description: The password for the default admin user. Please change this to something more secure.

Config.Name: Web front-end port
Config.Description: The default port for the web front-end.

Config.Name: LDAP port
Config.Description: The default port for LDAP connections.
